card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS warning text
card.fires_on: Words and word parts within long ALL-CAPS label passages, such as boxed warnings and precautions. It marks the next word in the capitalized sentence, such as ARE, AND, IN, or a partial word like PRO or EST.

modes.description: Small connecting words in capitalized warning sentences.

modes.label: List separators in caps
